What if you never washed your jeans?
Most people toss their jeans in the wash after just a few wears. Even the boss of Levi's said he almost never washes his! He said it helps jeans keep their shape and color.

But here's the twist. Freezing jeans doesn't really kill the germs, but spot cleaning and airing them out keeps them fresh longer, and they last longer too. Washing less also saves water, and jeans take a lot of water to make. If they smell or get stained, wash them inside out in cold water to keep the color.
